    Filtered maps with surjective or injective leading terms (toward Corollary 12.1) #

    Linear maps between finite graded spaces are filtered by the degrees they raise (OrderGe). A filtered map whose leading term is surjective (injective) is itself surjective (injective), and has a filtered right inverse; a graded map killed by the leading term of a filtered map with surjective leading term corrects to a filtered map killed by the map itself (exists_kernel_lift). These are the finite-filtration arguments of deformation-refinements.tex ("graded surjectivity supplies p_d... The finite filtration makes the process terminate").
